product_metadata.title: Incense Vietnam Nha Trang Agarwood ​Lying incens 5-Star Agarwood 100 Sticks (5 Stars Agarwood 100 Sticks)
features: This incense is made of nanmu oil and powder, which is fresh and natural, and does not contain any chemical fragrances. It is suitable for yoga, meditation, meditation, playing piano, tea tasting, etc., and all elegant activities.

Agarwood is a natural resource, originated in India, China and other countries. The main producing areas are Nha Trang, Sin Chau, Huian, Fusen, Hainan, etc. The quality is mainly distinguished by growth years and oil content. The higher the oil content, the stronger the fragrance. , The purer.

There are a total of 100 agarwood incense sticks in the box, with a diameter of about 1.3mm /0.05 inches and a length of 21cm/8.3 inches. The burning time for each is about 30 minutes.We include a mini incense burner, which is very convenient to carry and store.

After screening, we have carefully designed this grade of agarwood for the majority of agarwood lovers. The 4-star grade is suitable for beginners. The fragrance is light and elegant, and the first smell of agarwood will refresh people. Burn a stick of agarwood in the living room to receive Confucian scholars; burn a stick of agarwood in the bedroom to sleep peacefully.

The 5-star agarwood is suitable for artists, luthiers, tea masters, etc. who have some contact with agarwood. Burning an agarwood, dancing a cicada dance, drinking a cup of tea, stroking the sound of the piano, and sublimating the soul
